get.summary: Read Dew balance and prepaid storage allowance
get.description: Requires the account bearer. Returns account_id, asset_id, enabled, used_bytes, units_per_dew (1000000), monthly_units (20000000), yearly_units (200000000), monthly_xmr_atomic_units, yearly_xmr_atomic_units, and plan {period,expires_at,limit_bytes,balance}. Balance is integer millionths of Dew. XMR prices use integer atomic units (1 XMR = 1000000000000 atomic units), derived from the fixed node funding ratio, rounded up to fund the complete purchase. No fiat prices or external exchange-rate feed are used. Missing or unrepresentable XMR prices disable upgrades. The enabled node grants 10 MiB free, or 1 GiB until expires_at. Expiry blocks growth while preserving reads and deletions.

200.description: Account-scoped Dew balance and storage allowance; no-store

post.summary: Buy one month or one year of storage with Dew
post.description: Explicit prepaid purchase: monthly costs 20 Dew, yearly costs 200 Dew, each grants 1 GiB total. Display the fixed monthly_xmr_atomic_units or yearly_xmr_atomic_units price returned by GET before purchase. A configured fixed XMR funding ratio is required. Extends unexpired time or starts now. Does not auto-renew. The debit and allowance commit atomically. Preserve request_id on uncertain results: repeating it never charges or extends twice; changing the period for the same ID is rejected. Monero funding uses the existing account subaddress and confirmed deposit reconciliation.

409.description: Request ID reused for another period

503.description: Upgrades disabled or unavailable; retain the request ID
